systems.system: Stratégie Nationale pour la Connectivité Universelle (FDSU subsidised coverage sites)
systems.country_label: Stratégie Nationale pour la Connectivité Universelle
systems.platform: mobile operators' networks, subsidised by viability gap funding
systems.owner: Fonds de Développement du Service Universel (FDSU)
systems.tiers: rural and peri-urban localities: 40 pilot sites in phase 0 (10 per mobile operator) and about 300 sites in phase 1 across five FDSU zones; coverage of the locality, no local government office said to be connected
rural and peri-urban areas, developed within phase 1

note: The FDSU's site-scoring framework counts the presence of basic public infrastructure (schools, health centres, mairies, police posts) for 15 of 100 points when ranking localities for subsidised mobile coverage; it says nothing of connecting a mairie's own office, so no fact is taken.
